claim: translation source and adapter identity; not a semantic-equivalence certificate

hol4.role: source theorem prover and official OpenTheory proof exporter

holide.role: OpenTheory article to Dedukti proof translation

lambdapi.role: Dedukti checker and upstream Holide/STT-to-Rocq exporter

hol2dk.role: reference/reuse source for the production HOL-to-Rocq translation architecture

coq_hol_light.role: Rocq-side HOL mapping/alignment catalog and large-scale translation precedent

metarocq.role: final quotation of kernel-checked Rocq objects into PCUIC

trust_policy.source: HOL4 theorem objects must be exported by the official pinned OpenTheory logger from a clean pinned HOL4 checkout.
trust_policy.intermediate: Holide output is never trusted by exit status alone; the resulting Dedukti terms must be checked independently by pinned Lambdapi before export.
trust_policy.rocq: Every generated Rocq file must be accepted by the Rocq kernel. Generated theorem modules containing Admitted/admit are rejected.
trust_policy.coq_hol_light: The packaged coq-hol-light theorem database is not proof evidence because its fast-load theorems are distributed as axioms. Only pinned mapping sources/conventions are reusable automatically, and mapping assumptions must remain explicit.
trust_policy.pcuic: Only kernel-checked Rocq declarations are passed to the pinned MetaRocq PCUIC quotation API.
trust_policy.fail_closed: Unmapped symbols, dirty or wrong revisions, missing independent checks, generated admits, or tool identity mismatches block publication.
